messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in image pull failures for CUDA runtime images from nvcr.io across multiple regions. 95% of recent node provisioning attempts failed with 401/429. Auto-page oncall.
oncall-maya: Acked. I'm on the page and joining.
chris_infra: seeing same in eu-west and us-west. Provisioner logs show repeated 'manifest unknown' and 'quota exceeded' from nvcr. Example:
```
ERROR: rpc: failed to pull nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime -> status 429 Too Many Requests\nresponse: {"errors":[{"code":"TOO_MANY_REQUESTS","message":"rate limit exceeded"}]}
```
oncall-maya: thanks. Rolling incident to infra. chris, can you confirm which node pools are attempting pulls? any difference between Dedicated vs Hosted?
chris_infra: Dedicated pools (dedicated-gpu-*) and autoscaler nodes (k8s-provisioner) both hit. Provisioner retries are backing up queue.
olivia_sre: Customer impact check: I've flagged all in-flight node provisions. Early telemetry: ~7% of provisioning requests failed in last 30m; roughly 4 customer clusters saw repeated failures leading to slow node creation. No API 5xx surfaced to end-users yet, but job start times for some customers increased by 30-90s.
oncall-maya: mitigation plan: 1) throttle autoscaler concurrency 2) switch image source to internal mirrored cache where possible 3) temporarily prefer older cached tags (e.g., cuda:11.7) for quick boot 4) open ticket with NVCR and cloud provider.
platform-eng-bot: runbook snippet: to flip mirror on a kube cluster: `kubectl set image daemonset/instance-provisioner instance-provisioner=internal-registry.local/provisioner:cached` — ensure imagePullSecrets are correct.
chris_infra: doing a controlled change on one AZ in eu-west to verify mirror. Applying image override now.
chris_infra: applied to eu-west-1a. New nodes in that AZ booting and pulling from internal proxy - successful.
oncall-maya: good. Start rolling to other AZs but keep concurrency low. Olivia, update customer impact doc and message SRE channel.
olivia_sre: updating incident doc. Notifying account teams for affected customers: tag list sent to #customer-success: @acct-team-ml @enterprise-ops. Draft note: "We experienced delays in node provisioning due to third-party registry rate limiting; we've applied a temporary mirror and are working with vendor for a long-term fix."
product-ops: any customers with live failover needs? Should we enable fallback model routing for heavy workloads?
oncall-maya: product-ops: not necessary yet, impact is infra provisioning only. If models timeout on startup we may route queries to warm instances, will coordinate.
chris_infra: two mitigation knobs executed: reduced autoscaler parallel creates from 10 -> 3, enabled internal mirror for k8s-provisioner, and switched default CUDA tag to cuda:11.7-cached. Observed provisioning success go from 5% -> 92% in eu-west test.
incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 45m to olivia_sre. Current severity: SEV2 - degraded node provisioning; third-party registry rate limits. Pager escalation suppressed except for regression.
oncall-maya: I've created NVCR ticket and attached logs (case #NVCR-780102). Reached out to our vendor rep asking for: - burst quota increases - explanation of new throttling policy - ETA for resolution.
chris_infra: also filed cloud provider support case for possible proxy caching at edge (case #CLOUD-45912).
olivia_sre: collecting post-incident actions: 1) make internal mirror the default fallback for provisioning 2) instrument rate-limit metrics per registry 3) add registry quota alerting to paging rules 4) runbook update for oncall (how to flip mirrors and rollback).
oncall-maya: handoff: i'm leaving the channel to olivia_sre at 17:00 UTC. olivia, you have ops lead. keep paging off unless severity escalates.
olivia_sre: acknowledged. I'll monitor and coordinate vendor engagement. Closing customer-facing notice draft for review.
product-ops: will prepare a status blurb for dashboard: "Provisioning delays affecting a subset of GPU node creations due to upstream registry throttling. Mitigation in progress via internal caching; no active data exposure." Please review.
chris_infra: schedule follow-up postmortem with infra + platform + eng-ml to decide on permanent mirror / CDN caching. Also consider pinning smaller base images to reduce pulls.
oncall-maya: thanks everyone. Next update in 30m or earlier if things regress. :white_check_mark:
olivia_sre: 30m update: mirrors holding, vendor replied asking for logs and confirmed throttling change. They gave temporary quota increase for our account. Will update when they confirm long-term fix. Closing active mitigation window.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied and traffic rerouted to internal mirror. Monitor 24h for regression. Add action items to retrospective.
